build_amazon_titan_v2_config: build an AmazonTitanV2Config instance with normalize and dimensions parameters for Bedrock embeddings
get_config_amazon_titan_v2: get the current AmazonTitanV2Config as a dictionary of non-default parameters
get_supported_openai_params: get the list of supported OpenAI parameters for AmazonTitanV2Config
map_openai_params_to_bedrock: map OpenAI embedding parameters like dimensions and encoding_format to Bedrock Amazon Titan V2 format
transform_bedrock_embedding_response: transform a Bedrock Amazon Titan V2 embedding response list into a standardized EmbeddingResponse object
